claims.content: To review the auction performance history of an individual SKU by entering the Product ID and viewing the search results.

goal.raw_text: To review the auction performance history of an individual SKU by entering the Product ID and viewing the search results.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The SKU History option is available in the Administration Menu.
The SKU History page is available and provides the auction performance history of an individual SKU ("Product ID").
The Product ID for the individual SKU is available to be entered on the SKU History page.
The Auctioneer enters the Product ID and clicks on “Go” on the SKU History page.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer enters the Product ID and clicks on “Go” on the SKU History page.

claims.content: The Auctioneer enters the Product ID and clicks on “Go.”
The search results are displayed in two sections.

The top section displays Product ID; Short “On-Air” description from the SKU Creation application; Product Type; Unit Cost; P1 (Price); Thumbnail Image; Auction History: # of times scheduled, # of sales, churn rate; Buyer’s Name; Auction Available Quantity; Red Available Qty (red inventory realm); White Physical Qty; and Active Date.
The bottom section displays auction history data for the SKU on separate lines, including Auction Status, Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, and Reserve Amount (i.e., Opening Bid).
